_comment: Work Lamar puts your way. Edited here, reloaded on script start.
id          stable key; never change it once a save references it
name        the choice he offers you, in his words
brief       what he says when he explains it
done        what he says when you come back paid
targetGang  whose people you are going after -- their models and colours are used
zone        GET_NAME_OF_ZONE code the job happens in. A zone, not a coordinate: the mod
already knows where every zone is and finds its own patch of pavement, so a
job can never be authored into a wall.
targets     how many of them are waiting
homies      how many of yours ride out with you
payMin/payMax  cash, rolled between the two
rep         standing with your own gang for finishing it
minRank     rank before he will offer it at all

missions.name: Go see about some Ballas.
missions.brief: Couple of Ballas been standing on Rancho like they pay rent. Take some of the homies, go tell 'em with your hands. No guns -- I want 'em walking home embarrassed, not carried home.
missions.done: That's what I'm talking about. Word travels.

missions.name: Somebody needs a talking to.
missions.brief: Murrieta Heights. Some of theirs been running their mouth about the set. Roll over there with the homies and shut it.

missions.name: Take a car through Rancho.
missions.brief: Get a car, take a couple homies, and put some rounds through that corner on Rancho. Don't stop, don't get out, and don't come back with the same car.
missions.done: Heard that from three blocks away. That's the point.

missions.name: The Vagos need reminding.
missions.brief: La Mesa. Vagos been getting comfortable. Drive through, make some noise, get gone before the law shows up.
